proposals.title: stockholder proposal to reduce scope 3 emissions
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Company to substantially reduce greenhouse gas emissions of its energy products (Scope 3) in the medium and long term, as defined by the Company.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on impacts of net zero 2050 scenario
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audited report on whether and how a significant reduction in fossil fuel demand under the IEA Net Zero 2050 scenario would affect financial position and assumptions.
proposals.evidence: Given Chevron's current disclosures and robust strategy, planning, and risk management processes, your Board believes that the requested report is unnecessary.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding shift to public benefit corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board amend the certificate of incorporation to become a Public Benefit Corporation under Delaware law and submit the amendment for shareholder approval.
proposals.evidence: Converting to a public benefit corporation is unnecessary and not an appropriate way to ensure the Company meets its social and environmental responsibilities.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model legislation memberships, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: Your Board is confident that the Company's political activities are aligned with Chevron's goals and the long-term interests of our stockholders.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding independent chair
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring that, whenever possible, the Board Chair be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding special meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendments giving holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowners meeting without exceptions.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
